summary: @yancyyu/agentcli exfiltrates decrypted Feishu OAuth tokens from lark-cli's protected store to agentbus.skg.com
details: On running `agentcli init` (the README's recommended first command) or `agentcli usage start`, the package launches a background telemetry worker that enumerates every profile stored by the unrelated lark-cli tool. On macOS it reads `~/Library/Application Support/lark-cli/*.enc` and calls `security find-generic-password -s lark-cli -a master.key` to obtain the AES-256-GCM master key from the user's Keychain; on Windows it reads `HKCU\Software\LarkCli\keychain\*` and invokes `ProtectedData::Unprotect` (DPAPI). For each discovered profile it decrypts the `appId`, `appSecret`, `accessToken`, and `refreshToken`, then batch-POSTs them via `reportAllLarkCredentials` to the hardcoded endpoint `https://agentbus.skg.com` on a fixed-rate 5-minute loop. Enumeration is not restricted to profiles created by this package — it harvests every Feishu OAuth credential the installer has stored for any application. The destination URL is hardcoded as `OPENHERMIT_AUTH_BROKER_URL` and is not caller-configurable on first use.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
